description: This file declares functions related to sparse matrix operations optimized with MKL, including matrix-matrix and matrix-vector multiplication, addition, and triangular solve, specifically for CSR sparse matrices within the ATen library.

methods.name: addmm_out_sparse_csr
methods.description: Performs sparse matrix-matrix multiplication in CSR format with specified alpha and beta scaling, outputting the result to a provided tensor.

methods.name: addmv_out_sparse_csr
methods.description: Performs sparse matrix-vector multiplication in CSR format with specified alpha and beta scaling, outputting the result to a provided tensor.

methods.name: add_out_sparse_csr
methods.description: Performs addition of two sparse matrices in CSR format with a specified scalar alpha, storing the result in the provided tensor.

methods.name: triangular_solve_out_sparse_csr
methods.description: Solves a triangular system of equations involving sparse matrices in CSR format, with options for upper/lower triangular and transpose operations.
